description: Old name for plan_tests; use plan_tests.

acceptanceCriteria.description: One criterion per entry, as the ticket states them.

changed.description: The branch, and what you changed in a sentence or two.

outOfScope.description: What this ticket deliberately does not do.

pages.description: The pages this feature adds or changes.

proposal.description: Your tests, once plan_tests has told you the rules. Leave out on the first call.

access.description: permissions: who may see or do what once inside. sign_in: signing in and out itself. none: neither.

area.description: The area of the app this feature lives in, as its sidebar names it (Companies): one Tada already knows when it fits.

as.description: The role it runs as, as the app names it; null for the default login.

covers.description: The numbers of the acceptance criteria this journey proves. Empty when none were given.

needs.description: Other journeys of this plan, by name, that must pass before this one can run, for example "Access taken away" needs "Admin creates a viewer role". Empty when it stands alone.

says.description: What should happen and why, said before it is shown.

name.description: The feature, named exactly as the ticket names it.

notBrowserCheckable.description: What the ticket asks for that a browser cannot check, each with the criteria numbers it accounts for.

ticketRef.description: The ticket id as the tracker writes it (SOL-123), or null.

uses.description: Other features this proof needs to exist first, by name.

repo.description: The app, as "owner/name". Left out, the workspace's only app.

roles.description: Who uses it, and what each may and may not do.

setup.description: What must exist first, for example "a client named Acme Holding".

text.description: The ticket description: what the feature should do and for whom.

ticket.description: The ticket id as the tracker writes it, for example SOL-123.

title.description: The ticket title, exactly as the tracker shows it.

name: plan_feature
